name: codex-routecraft
description: Risk-gated adaptive orchestration for Codex: Sol owns architecture and acceptance while work is selectively routed to the cheapest viable GPT-5.6 lane.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive Sol-led routing with parent verification and risk-gated review.
interface.longDescription: RouteCraft keeps GPT-5.6 Sol as the architect and acceptance owner, defaults to solo execution, and delegates only when a cheaper lane can safely substitute for root implementation. It can route bounded work to Luna, judgment-heavy work to Terra, parallelize independent workstreams, and request a fresh Sol review for high-risk changes. The parent always inspects the complete diff and reruns verification before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-routecraft:orchestration to build this feature with adaptive routing and verification.
Use RouteCraft to choose the cheapest safe lane, implement this change, and verify the complete diff.
Use RouteCraft for this task; parallelize only independent work and add fresh Sol review only if risk warrants it.
